sentences.zh: 因此，他们必须争取至少一位保守派大法官才能获胜。

sentences.en: So, they have to pick up at least one conservative justice to prevail.
sentences.zh: 所以在就业歧视案中，他们不仅争取到了首席大法官，

sentences.en: So, in the employment discrimination case, they picked up not only the chief justice,
sentences.zh: 还争取到了特朗普任命的大法官之一戈萨奇，他实际上执笔了多数意见书。

sentences.en: but also Justice Gorsuch, one of the Trump appointees who actually wrote the majority decision.
sentences.zh: 在“梦想者”案即DACA案中，他们争取到了执笔多数意见书的首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨。

sentences.en: In the DREAMers case, the DACA case, they picked up Chief Justice John Roberts, who wrote the majority opinion.
sentences.zh: 现在在堕胎案中，他们再次争取到了首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨，他与多数派一起投票，但没有加入其推理过程。

sentences.en: And now, in the abortion case, they again picked up Chief Justice John Roberts, who voted with the majority but didn't join its reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇为什么这种情况不断发生，法院的自由派阵营不断争取到这些保守派大法官。

sentences.en: I'm curious why this keeps happening, that the liberal wing of the court keeps picking up these conservative justices.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这样问，是因为我们已经与你，亚当，还有我们的同事多次探讨过，

sentences.en: And the reason I ask this is because we have talked so many times with you, Adam, and with our colleagues,
sentences.zh: 导致保守派大法官进入最高法院候选名单、被选中并最终得到确认的激烈审查过程。

sentences.en: about the intense vetting process that has led to conservative justices making it into the pipeline for the Supreme Court, getting picked, and then confirmed.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，保守派法律机构在这一审查过程中极其谨慎，

sentences.en: And my sense is that the conservative legal apparatus is extremely careful about this vetting process,
sentences.zh: 它期望这些法官——如果我没有过度简化的话——能够始终如一地以保守派的方式投票。

sentences.en: and it expects these judges, and tell me if I'm oversimplifying, to vote consistently and conservatively.
sentences.zh: 然而。

sentences.en: And yet.
sentences.zh: 所以，你说得对，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So, you're right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 这太非同寻常了。

sentences.en: It's extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 保守派法律运动投入了大量精力来寻找他们可以指望的、会按照他们意愿投票的人。

sentences.en: The conservative legal movement has put so much energy into identifying people they can count on, who will vote the way they want.
sentences.zh: 而且审查过程非常激烈。

sentences.en: And the vetting process is intense.
sentences.zh: 确认战如此激烈的原因为，双方都确信

sentences.en: And the reason the confirmation battles are so heated is because people on both sides are convinced
sentences.zh: 一旦这些人进入法院，他们就会朝着右翼方向投票。

sentences.en: that once one of these people gets on the court, they will vote in a right-wing direction.
sentences.zh: 但这并非总是如此。

sentences.en: But it turns out that if you put a serious judge on the Supreme Court and give him or her life tenure,
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，如果你把一位认真的法官送上最高法院并授予他或她终身任期，

sentences.en: they are going to follow their judicial commitments, sometimes in directions that aren't political but are legal.
sentences.zh: 他们就会遵循自己的司法承诺，有时其方向不是政治性的，而是法律性的。

sentences.en: And so in these three cases, they're all different.
sentences.zh: 所以在处理这三个案件时，它们各不相同。

sentences.en: But they all conform to jurisprudential commitments of the justices who voted that way.
sentences.zh: 但它们都符合投赞成票的大法官们的法理承诺。

sentences.en: So, in the employment discrimination case, Justice Gorsuch thinks the law simply means what it says, and he couldn't get away from that.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那个就业歧视案中，戈萨奇大法官认为法律字面意思就是如此，而他无法摆脱这一点。

sentences.en: And that's a conservative idea.
sentences.zh: 而这是一个保守派的理念。

sentences.en: In the DACA case, Chief Justice Roberts thought the Trump administration simply hadn't offered an adequate reason for winding down the program.
sentences.zh: 在DACA案中，罗伯茨首席大法官认为特朗普政府根本没有为逐步取消该计划提供充分的理由。

sentences.en: That's also a conservative idea.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个保守派的理念。

sentences.en: And then in this latest case, the abortion case, Chief Justice Roberts said, listen, we have a precedent on point.
sentences.zh: 而在最近的这个案件，即堕胎案中，罗伯茨首席大法官说，听着，我们有一个相关的判例。

sentences.en: We're supposed to follow precedent.
sentences.zh: 我们理应遵循先例。

sentences.en: That's basically a conservative idea.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一个保守派的理念。

sentences.en: So depending on how you think about these cases, they may be politically liberal, but in an important sense, judicially conservative.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论你如何看待这些案件，它们在政治上可能是自由派的，但在一个重要的意义上，它们在司法上是保守的。

sentences.en: I have to imagine that the greatest disappointment for this right-wing legal apparatus that you described is with Justice Roberts,
sentences.zh: 我不得不猜想，你所描述的这个右翼法律机器对大法官罗伯茨感到最失望的地方，

sentences.en: because he has been the most consistent swing vote to swing over to the liberals.
sentences.zh: 因为他一直是倒向自由派的最稳定的摇摆票。

sentences.en: And I hear you just saying that he's coming up with a conservative legal rationale in each decision.
sentences.zh: 我听到你刚刚说他在每个裁决中都提出了保守派的法律根据。

sentences.en: But I have to imagine this pattern is complicating his reputation with the people who supported his nomination.
sentences.zh: 但我不得不猜想，这种模式正在损害他在那些支持他提名的人心中的声誉。

sentences.en: Oh, that's way an understatement.
sentences.zh: 哦，这绝对是轻描淡写了。

sentences.en: Chief Justice Roberts consistently seems more concerned about the reputation of the court and his reputation among Democrats and the media than the role of law.
sentences.zh: 罗伯茨首席大法官似乎一直以来都更关心法院的声誉以及他在民主党人和媒体中的声誉，而不是法律的作用。

sentences.en: The right-wing, the conservative legal movement, Senator Ted Cruz, Senator Tom Cotton, are furious with John Roberts.
sentences.zh: 右翼、保守派法律运动、参议员特德·克鲁兹、参议员汤姆·科顿，都对约翰·罗伯茨愤怒至极。

sentences.en: I would recommend that he resign and travel to Iowa for the caucuses and see if he can earn the votes of his fellow Americans.
sentences.zh: 我建议他辞职，去爱荷华州参加党团会议，看看他能不能赢得同胞们的选票。

sentences.en: I mean, maybe they could forgive him his two votes for upholding the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 我是说，也许他们能原谅他支持平价医疗法案的两票。

sentences.en: Maybe they could forgive him in the census case for not letting the Trump administration add a question on citizenship.
sentences.zh: 也许在人口普查案中，他们能原谅他没有让特朗普政府增加关于国籍的问题。

sentences.en: Judging is not a game.
sentences.zh: 司法不是一场游戏。

sentences.en: But sadly, over recent years, more and more Chief Justice Roberts has been playing games.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，近年来，罗伯茨首席大法官越来越多地在玩弄政治游戏。

sentences.en: But to come to three liberal conclusions in the space of two weeks in three different blockbuster cases is a bitter, bitter pill for them to swallow.
sentences.zh: 但要在短短两周内，在三个不同的轰动性案件中得出三个自由派的结论，对他们来说是一颗极苦、极苦的药丸。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And they're saying so.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也直言不讳。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But here's the thing, Michael.
sentences.zh: 但关键是，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Roberts, in moving to the center of the court, has become the most powerful Chief Justice since at least 1937.
sentences.zh: 罗伯茨在向法院中心靠拢的过程中，已经成为了自1937年以来最有权势的首席大法官。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The idea of both being the Chief Justice and the Swing Justice, as it were, is almost unheard of.
sentences.zh: 兼任首席大法官和摇摆大法官这种概念，几乎是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: But what you have in Chief Justice Roberts is someone who's been in the majority 98% of the time so far this term.
sentences.zh: 但在罗伯茨首席大法官身上，你会发现他在本期开庭至今98%的案件中都站在多数派一边。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And he's been in the majority in every 5-4 decision so far, which looks like it will set a record for a Chief Justice if it lasts through the end of the term.
sentences.zh: 而且他在迄今为止每一次5比4的裁决中都投了多数票，如果这种情况持续到本期结束，这似乎将创下首席大法官的纪录。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So perhaps he has alienated the right, but he has amassed a tremendous amount of influence as a justice on this court.
sentences.zh: 所以，也许他已经疏远了右翼，但他作为本院大法官，积累了巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, people talk about the Roberts Court because you always talk about the court by the name of the Chief Justice.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们谈论罗伯茨法院，因为你总是以首席大法官的名字来称呼法院。

sentences.en: But this is really the Roberts Court in a second sense, too, that John Roberts is driving this train.
sentences.zh: 但这也是第二个意义上的罗伯茨法院，因为约翰·罗伯茨在掌控着这列火车。

sentences.en: You established a narrative for us about a year ago, Adam, around this question of John Roberts.
sentences.zh: 大约一年前，亚当，你围绕约翰·罗伯茨这个议题，为我们梳理了一个脉络。

sentences.en: And you accurately predicted he might end up being a swing vote on a question like abortion.
sentences.zh: 你准确地预测到，在像堕胎这样的话题上，他最终可能会成为一张摇摆票。

sentences.en: And when we have talked about him,
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论他时，

sentences.en: you said that he prizes the reputation of the Supreme Court as a nonpartisan institution and that he might prize that reputation above his own kind of most natural legal instincts.
sentences.zh: 你说他极为珍视最高法院作为非党派机构的声誉，而且他可能会把这种声誉看得比他自己那种最自然的法律直觉还要重要。

sentences.en: Is that what you think may be at play here?
sentences.zh: 你认为这可能是这里起作用的原因吗？

sentences.en: Or is it possible that we just didn't quite understand his legal instincts the entire time?
sentences.zh: 还是说，有没有可能我们自始至终都没有完全理解他的法律直觉？

sentences.en: I think a large part of what explains this is what John Roberts goes around saying all the time and nobody takes seriously.
sentences.zh: 我认为，很大一部分原因可以用约翰·罗伯茨到处挂在嘴边、却没人当真的一句话来解释。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: That the court is not a political institution.
sentences.zh: 即法院不是一个政治机构。

sentences.en: We do not speak for the people, but we speak for the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 我们不代表人民发言，我们为宪法代言。

sentences.en: Our role is very clear.
sentences.zh: 我们的角色非常清晰。

sentences.en: And I think he's demonstrating that commitment, that these are not, you know, sort of empty civics lesson statements that he makes in his public comments,
sentences.zh: 我认为他正在践行这种承诺，这些并不是他在公开讲话中说的一些空洞的公民课式的套话，

sentences.en: but that he is authentically committed to them.
sentences.zh: 而是他是发自内心地致力于这些原则。

sentences.en: We do not sit on opposite sides of an aisle.
sentences.zh: 我们不坐在走廊的两侧。

sentences.en: We do not caucus in separate rooMs.
sentences.zh: 我们不在不同的房间开党团会议。

sentences.en: We do not serve one party or one intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我们不服务于某个政党或某项利益。

sentences.en: We serve one nation.
sentences.zh: 我们服务于同一个国家。

sentences.en: And I want to assure all of you that we will continue to do that to the best of our abilities, whether times are calm or contentious.
sentences.zh: 我想向你们所有人保证，无论时局平静还是充满争议，我们将继续尽我们最大的努力做到这一点。

sentences.en: Thanks very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I think he earnestly believes in the legal conclusions he's drawn.
sentences.zh: 我认为他真诚地相信自己得出的法律结论。

sentences.en: But at least incidentally, it helps maintain the institutional prestige, authority, legitimacy of the Supreme Court if it doesn't break along predictable ideological lines.
sentences.zh: 但至少顺带一提，如果法院不按照可预测的意识形态阵营分裂，将会有助于维护最高法院的机构威望、权威和合法性。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So in a way, he's being the change he wants to see, which does fit with who he is, but may also stretch who he is.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，他正在身体力行他希望看到的改变，这确实符合他的为人，但也可能会突破他原有的本色。

sentences.en: Yeah, okay.
sentences.zh: 好的，行。

sentences.en: Adam, it feels like from everything you're saying about Chief Justice John Roberts that we may be getting an answer to the biggest question of all about how he may rule,
sentences.zh: 亚当，从你对首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨所说的一切来看，我们似乎即将找到关于他将如何裁决的最大疑问的答案，

sentences.en: which is on any kind of challenge to Roe v.
sentences.zh: 也就是针对罗诉韦德案的任何

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 挑战。

sentences.en: Because the rulings of the past couple weeks, and especially the ruling on the Louisiana law, suggest that he favors precedent, does not want to polarize the country,
sentences.zh: 因为过去几周的裁决，尤其是关于路易斯安那州法律的裁决，表明他倾向于遵循先例，不想让国家两极分化，

sentences.en: and collectively that would all suggest – tell me if I'm wrong here – that he would be inclined to support the precedent that is Roe v.
sentences.zh: 综合这些来看，这一切似乎都在暗示——如果我错了请纠正我——如果罗诉韦德案受到挑战，他会倾向于支持作为先例的

sentences.en: Wade if it is challenged.
sentences.zh: 罗诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Well, so I think we have some substantial evidence for that proposition in today's ruling.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们在今天的裁决中为这一主张找到了一些实质性的证据。

sentences.en: He took precedent very seriously in an abortion case.
sentences.zh: 在处理一起堕胎案时，他非常严肃地对待先例。

sentences.en: But it's not as though John Roberts has never voted to overrule precedent.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说约翰·罗伯茨从未投过票去推翻先例。

sentences.en: He voted to overrule precedent in Citizens United and in other cases.
sentences.zh: 他在“联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案”以及其他案件中都投了票推翻先例。

sentences.en: And he's set out a fairly elaborate set of principles for when precedents can be overruled.
sentences.zh: 并且他为何时可以推翻先例制定了一套相当详尽的原则。

sentences.en: And it's not clear to me that just because he thought this one precedent, which is trivial in comparison to the abortion right itself in Roe,
sentences.zh: 而且在我看来，并不清楚仅仅因为他认为这一个先例——与罗诉韦德案中的堕胎权相比微不足道——

sentences.en: will give you the answer of how he will treat Roe.
sentences.zh: 就会给你提供关于他将如何对待罗诉韦德案的答案。

sentences.en: So I wouldn't count any chickens here.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在不会过早地打包票。

sentences.en: But there is more evidence Monday than there was last week that the Chief Justice takes precedent quite seriously.
sentences.zh: 但周一出现的证据比上周更多，表明首席大法官相当严肃地对待先例。

sentences.en: Adam, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 亚当，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Yes, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: On Monday evening, both the White House and President Trump's campaign issued statements denouncing the Supreme Court's ruling on abortion.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，白宫和特朗普总统的竞选团队都发表声明，谴责最高法院关于堕胎的裁决。

sentences.en: Without naming him, the statement from the campaign appeared to criticize Chief Justice Roberts, saying, quote,
sentences.zh: 竞选团队的声明在没有点名的情况下似乎批评了罗伯茨首席大法官，称，引述如下：

sentences.en: Five unelected Supreme Court justices decided to insert their political agenda in place of democratically determined policies.
sentences.zh: 五位未经选举产生的最高法院大法官决定将他们的政治议程强加进来，取代民主程序决定的政策。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Global deaths from the coronavirus have now surpassed 500,000, prompting a new wave of restrictions.
sentences.zh: 全球新冠肺炎死亡人数现已超过50万，引发了新一波限制措施。

sentences.en: China imposed a strict lockdown on nearly half a million people in a county south of Beijing in an effort to contain an outbreak there that is challenging the country's claim to have beaten back the virus.
sentences.zh: 为了控制当地卷土重来并对该国宣称击退病毒的说法构成挑战的疫情，中国对北京以南一个县的近五十万人实施了严格的封锁。

sentences.en: In the U.S., several states moved to delay reopenings.
sentences.zh: 在美国，几个州采取行动推迟重新开放。

sentences.en: We must hit pause on the resumption of indoor dining.
sentences.zh: 我们必须按下室内餐饮恢复营业的暂停键。

sentences.en: In New Jersey, Governor Phil Murphy scrapped a plan to open restaurants for limited indoor dining later this week, saying it posed too great a risk.
sentences.zh: 在新泽西州，州长菲尔·墨菲取消了本周晚些时候允许餐厅开放有限室内餐饮的计划，称这带来了太大的风险。

sentences.en: Given the current situation in numerous other states, we do not believe it is prudent at this time to push forward with what is, in effect, a sedentary indoor activity,
sentences.zh: 鉴于其他许多州的当前形势，我们认为目前推进这种实际上属于久坐不动的室内活动是不明智的，

sentences.en: especially when we know that this virus moves differently indoors than out, making it even more deadly.
sentences.zh: 特别是当我们知道这种病毒在室内和室外的传播方式不同，这使得它更加致命。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that intelligence officials gave President Trump a written briefing months ago,
sentences.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，情报官员几个月前向特朗普总统提交了一份书面简报，

sentences.en: laying out their conclusion that Russia offered and paid out bounties to militants in Afghanistan to kill U.S.
sentences.zh: 阐述了他们的结论，即俄罗斯曾向阿富汗的武装分子提供并发放赏金，用于杀死驻那里的美国

sentences.en: and coalition troops there.
sentences.zh: 部队和联军部队。

sentences.en: So far, Trump has denied ever being briefed on the Russian bounties.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，特朗普一直否认曾听取过关于俄罗斯悬赏杀人的简报。

sentences.en: But the intelligence has provoked a furor because the Russian bounties may be linked to the death of three U.S.
sentences.zh: 但这一情报引发了轩然大波，因为俄罗斯的悬赏可能与三名美国海军陆战队员

sentences.en: Marines in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 在阿富汗的死亡有关。

sentences.en: And because the White House has not authorized any response.
sentences.zh: 而且因为白宫没有授权采取任何回应措施。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《切割机秀》节目中，我们正准备迎接节日期间的宾客接待。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而喝断片。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《切割机秀》。
